subject: general
question: Who among the following was Akbar’s revenue minister?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Todar Mal.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• During the reign of **Emperor Akbar, Todar Mal **served as the** Mughal Empire's **Finance Minister.
 
• He served as both the **Joint Wazir **and the **Vakil-us-Sultanat.**
 
• He was a** Mansabdar of 4000 **and one of the most prominent lords in the **Mughal Empire.**
 
• He served as one of **Akbar's Navaratnas.**
 
• There were** 15 more Dewans** under Todar Mal who were nominated for the **15 Subahs of Akbar.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Tansen:**

 
 
• Tansen played **classical Indian music.**
 
• At the age of **roughly 60**, **Vaishnava musician **Tansen joined **Akbar's court **in **1562.**
 
 
 
• **Raja Man Singh:**
 
 
• In Rajputana, Raja Man Singh was the **29th Kachwaha Rajput Raja of Amer**.
 
• He was **Akbar**, the Mughal emperor's, most powerful and **trusted commander. **
 
• **H**e was one of the **Navaratnas.**
 
 
 
• **Birbal:**
 
 
• **Birbal** served as the **main army commander** at the court of Mughal emperor Akbar.
 
• He was a** Saraswat Hindu Bhatt Brahmin counsellor.​ **
